title: The Blinking Router
story: The home internet stopped during a film. The router lights were blinking red, so Kenan turned it off. He waited one minute and turned it on again. The lights became green, but the film would not play. His sister checked the cables and pushed one plug in firmly. The film started at once. Kenan wrote the steps on a card and stuck it beside the router.
